claims.value: The source map labels this region Manchu Empire, although the Qing emperor had abdicated in February 1912. The Republic of China received full US diplomatic recognition in 1913. The republican government had not unified all of China under its control; the generalized 1914 outline should therefore be read as a schematic region rather than a verified boundary of central authority.

scope.description: The upstream Manchu Empire label is anachronistic after the 1912 abdication. Republican institutional context is supported; this generalized outline is not proof of uniform government control. Separately mapped Xinjiang and Tibet and omitted Taiwan remain outside this feature’s facts.
